title: The Falcons finally have a QB. Now Michael Penix Jr. must prove he's a good one | Opinion

sources.name: Yahoo Sports NFL
sources.title: The Falcons finally have a QB. Now Michael Penix Jr. must prove he's a good one | Opinion
sources.description: Michael Penix Jr., coming off a torn ACL, will start for the Falcons on Thursday night. He must prove himself to a leadership group that didn't draft him.
